baseline_sha_note: design baseline_sha.repinned_main_sha; registry_baseline_sha f5d32477 is historical

caveat.d1_scope: D1 does not change E-lane caches; X1/X2 exporter fixes would require field-cache v2 plus new design_ids, and the frozen v1 caches stay unchanged
caveat.n_lane: N-lane cells carry reverse sanitary paths as authored pre-D1
caveat.n_vs_e: N-vs-E contrasts are partly reverse-paths plus sampling, not field generation alone
caveat.sanitary_branch: every sanitary_branch source cell's b_v_h is dominated by the endpoint-sampling artefact

metric.endpoint_rule: campaign right-endpoint sum: after each 1 h transport_step, retained total mass fraction is observed; b_v_h = sum_z volume_z * AUC(C_z) / DESIGN_TRACER_MASS, which reduces to the endpoint mass-fraction sum times epoch_hours for this tracer
metric.exact_rule: b_v_h = integral_0^12h sum_z retained_mass_fraction_z(t) dt for t0_pulse; t0_t1_split is 0.5*integral_0^12h + 0.5*integral_0^11h for the half pulse injected at t = 1 h
metric.name: b_v_h

operator_source.E: ContamXTransportEngine built from frozen field_cache entries/flows plus spatial_layout at baseline_sha
operator_source.N: native ContamTransportEngine built from data/platforms/<hull>/{spatial_layout,air_flow_paths}.json at baseline_sha with the arm op list applied in memory
operator_source.P: ContamXTransportEngine built from frozen field_cache entries/flows (baseline arm only) plus spatial_layout at baseline_sha
